lib = '''"""Shared helpers for ARC-style grid tasks."""

def extend_diagonals(grid):
    """Complete same-color diagonal runs (len >= 2) across background cells; 0 is empty and extensions never go down-right."""
    from collections import Counter
    H, W = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    bg = Counter(c for row in grid for c in row).most_common(1)[0][0]
    bgset = {bg, 0}
    g = [row[:] for row in grid]
    for dr, dc in ((1, 1), (1, -1)):  # main and anti diagonals
        for s in range(-(W - 1), H):
            if dr == 1 and dc == 1:
                cells = [(r, r - s) for r in range(H) if 0 <= r - s < W]
            else:
                cells = [(r, s - r) for r in range(H) if 0 <= s - r < W]
            run = []
            for cell in cells + [None]:
                if cell and g[cell[0]][cell[1]] not in bgset and (
                        not run or g[cell[0]][cell[1]] == g[run[-1][0]][run[-1][1]]):
                    run.append(cell)
                    continue
                if len(run) >= 2:
                    color = g[run[0][0]][run[0][1]]
                    for start, step in ((run[0], (-dr, -dc)), (run[-1], (dr, dc))):
                        if step == (1, 1):  # never extend down-right
                            continue
                        r, c = start[0] + step[0], start[1] + step[1]
